SRC-199:R001.text: A requested explanation of protocol deviation must answer that request; an engineering inventory or general handoff cannot substitute.

SRC-199:R002.text: Use both supplied FreeBuff handoffs as fixed regression witnesses; separate verified deviations from genuine recovery/transport boundaries and unverified claims.

SRC-199:R003.text: Diagnosis names actual evidence, violated rule and owner, cause, and corrective action; never invent an internal motive, successful recovery or ticket completion.

SRC-199:R004.text: Reuse the common response/artifact owner and available host enforcement. Check instruction/distribution freshness and strongest actually supported FreeBuff surfaces; disclose advisory or unverified runtime limits.
